trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing edge; irregular pixel-amplitude peaks most pronounced on the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Medial trailing edges exhibit a concave curve transitioning to convex curvature at the lateral terminals.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant yellow-brown surface discoloration (diatom film) covering approximately 30% of the upper fluke lobes.
